name: Apex Legacy 50K · holder's EOD reading, not Apex's rule
source: Account holder 2026-09-27: "apex legacy with the 10 contract max", "2000 EOD TRAIL DD locks at 50100 and 3000 profit target", no consistency rule, passable in 1 day. No daily loss limit was named for Legacy. Floor: $2,000 below the EOD peak, locking at $50,100 (+$100) once the EOD peak reaches +$2,100. THIS FILE IS THE ACCOUNT HOLDER'S END-OF-DAY READING, NOT WHAT APEX'S HELP CENTRE SAYS. Apex (https://apextraderfunding.com/help-center/evaluation-accounts-ea/legacy-evaluation-rules/, read 2026-10-11; research/prop-portfolio/2026-10-01-l2/APEX300_RULES.md): a Legacy account's threshold trails the highest LIVE balance during trades (intraday, open profit included), not the end-of-day balance; the 50K's drawdown is $2,500, not $2,000; the evaluation needs 7 trading days unless a one-day-pass promotion is on; on Tradovate the evaluation's threshold never stops trailing. This simulator cannot trail an intraday high, so these odds are the FRIENDLY reading: Apex's own rule passes less often and busts more often. The payout block is LucidFlex's, not Apex's (Apex: 8 trading days, 5 of them >= $50, largest day <= 30% of the profit, a safety net, at most $2,000 a payout; the PA trades half size until the safety net). Apex bans automated trading on Performance Accounts.
